URLs and near-URLs that must not become links, or not new ones: code,
markdown's own links, other schemes, and a scheme with no host. The format
is link.txt's.

~~ case: inline code
use `https://x.org` here
~~ want
<p id="p1">use <code>https://x.org</code> here</p>
~~ case: a fence
```
curl https://x.org/a
```
~~ want
<pre><code>curl https://x.org/a
</code></pre>
~~ case: a fence with a language
```sh
curl http://143.244.172.148:9210/
```
~~ want
<pre><code class="language-sh">curl http://143.244.172.148:9210/
</code></pre>
~~ case: a markdown link is as it was
see [the docs](https://x.org/a) now
~~ want
<p id="p1">see <a href="https://x.org/a">the docs</a> now</p>
~~ case: a markdown link whose text is its URL is one link
[https://x.org](https://x.org)
~~ want
<p id="p1"><a href="https://x.org">https://x.org</a></p>
~~ case: a URL in a link's text stays its text
[see https://a.org/"<b>](https://b.org)
~~ want
<p id="p1"><a href="https://b.org">see https://a.org/&quot;&lt;b&gt;</a></p>
~~ case: an angle-bracket link is as it was
<https://x.org>
~~ want
<p id="p1"><a href="https://x.org">https://x.org</a></p>
~~ case: an image is as it was
![https://x.org/a.png](https://x.org/a.png)
~~ want
<p id="p1"><img src="https://x.org/a.png" alt="https://x.org/a.png"></p>
~~ case: inside a word
xhttps://x.org and 2http://x.org
~~ want
<p id="p1">xhttps://x.org and 2http://x.org</p>
~~ case: other schemes
ftp://x.org mailto:a@x.org file:///etc/hosts www.x.org
~~ want
<p id="p1">ftp://x.org mailto:a@x.org file:///etc/hosts www.x.org</p>
~~ case: a scheme alone
http:// and https://.
~~ want
<p id="p1">http:// and https://.</p>
~~ case: no host after the scheme
https:///path and https://-x and https://_x
~~ want
<p id="p1">https:///path and https://-x and https://_x</p>
~~ case: a placeholder for the host
http://<box>:9200/safari/
~~ want
<p id="p1">http://&lt;box&gt;:9200/safari/</p>
~~ case: a scheme in capitals
HTTPS://X.ORG
~~ want
<p id="p1">HTTPS://X.ORG</p>
~~ case: an HTML block passes through as written
<div>
https://x.org
</div>
~~ want
<div>
https://x.org
</div>
